title: Spec of a principal localization is an open immersion
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $f\in A$, and let $A_f$ be the localization of $A$ at the multiplicative set $\{1,f,f^2,\dots\}$. Then the morphism of schemes $\operatorname{Spec}A_f\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ induced by the localization map $A\to A_f$ is an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion] (with image the principal open $D(f)$).
